risks.risk: The disc drive may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A photo of the console with the disc slot open or a video of a disc being inserted.

risks.risk: The internal storage capacity (500GB vs 1TB) is unknown.
risks.proof: A photo of the 'Storage' settings screen in the console menu.

risks.risk: The console may have a 'Game Error' or be banned from the Xbox Live network.
risks.proof: A video showing the console successfully connecting to the internet and launching a game.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and reaching the home screen.
Photo of the 'Storage' settings screen showing the hard drive capacity.
Photo of the disc drive area.
Video of the console connected to a TV and a controller working.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified as a Microsoft Xbox One S. It can be priced at its worst-case value (non-working, disc drive missing, 500GB) until proof of functionality is provided.
